prompt: As of August 3 2024, which surviving building of the World's Columbian Exposition of 1893 sits on the same street as a skyscraper over 1,000 feet tall? Give the surviving building's current name.
answer:
The surviving building is the **World’s Congress Building**, now known as the **Art Institute of Chicago**, at 111 South Michigan Avenue.

It is on the same street as **875 North Michigan Avenue**—formerly the John Hancock Center—which rises more than 1,000 feet.
